rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is direct property damage covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch overhang where approximately 4 shingles were blown off in a weekend wind event. No water intrusion or secondary damage. Estimated repair cost: $400. This is a straightforward low-severity property damage claim.

case_facts.description: wind blew approximately 4 shingles off overhang
case_facts.secondary_damage: none - no water intrusion to house
